# Set Max Health

Source: [wiki article 4422](../archive/4422.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Set Max Health](../../api/actions/set-max-health.md).

<a id="wiki-4422-n1"></a>

- Set Max Health uses a percentage of raw max health and clamps current health so it cannot exceed the new maximum.
